14c_1_band_structure.png: The free Kohn-Sham levels against the 3-momentum $k$ (units of $H$) at the slice $a_{4,0} = 0$ for $m = 1$, $L = 3$; vertical axis the level in units of $m$. The brane band (thick) starts at the zero mode and rises with the slope $c = 1.9051$ (dotted line) and then more slowly; the other levels start at or above the bulk edge $1.2923\,m$ (dash-dotted); the dashed curve is the brane band of the blocks $j = -1$, the mirror image $-\varepsilon$, which belongs to the sea.
